hook.name: OHMVAULT VaultHook
hook.description: Charges a time-decaying fee (80% at launch, decaying to 5% over 60 seconds) on both swap directions via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, skimming tokens directly from the pool. Harvested fees are split 40% into a hook-owned locked full-range LP position and 60% to treasury. Records a running minimum OHM reserve and a 10-minute TWAP for use by external bond and emission contracts.
